answer: Each agent that wants to trade must lock a refundable 75 POA bond for 28 days, so a farm creating a thousand fakes has to park 75,000 POA it cannot spend elsewhere. A jade receipt is issued for every bond, recording the wallet and device key in a public register. Independent auditors drawn at random each week compare new receipts, and any two accounts that mirror the same device key lose both bonds and are barred. A peer who spots a duplicate can whisper the evidence to the auditors.
